children: Live cattle futures settle down 0.2% to $2.27975 a pound. This decline snapped a 2-day winning streak, and goes against the general trend, with cattle pushing higher since early September. Cattle has gained 7.6% since Sept. 1, according to data from FactSet. An improvement to underlying fundamentals is behind improved futures prices, says Steiner Consulting Group in a note. "Packer margins have improved dramatically for summer levels and have been in positive territory for at least six weeks," the firm says. (kirk.maltais@wsj.com)
